# CHECK THE SHOP

San Jose cannabis license-record lookup. State status and city address matches are separate. Results are dated snapshots, not findings of legality.

- [One shop. Two records.](https://check-the-shop.vercel.app/guide-two-checks.html)
- [The sign isn’t always the legal name.](https://check-the-shop.vercel.app/guide-names-and-addresses.html)
- [Can’t find the shop? Start here.](https://check-the-shop.vercel.app/guide-no-match.html)

- [Sources](https://check-the-shop.vercel.app/sources.html)
- [Public data](https://check-the-shop.vercel.app/data.json)
